findings.claim: Repair-installed device_notes claims the row's own closing seam (web:Eccl.3.22|web:Eccl.4.1) is 'confirmed empty' of any shared-root catchword, but the root ראה straddles that exact seam (3:22's own לִרְא֔וֹת 'to see' and 4:1's opening וָאֶרְאֶה֙ 'and I saw'), the same raiti/ra'ah observation-formula this writer treats as a genuine device elsewhere in this monologue (including this row's own opening verdict verb and the two other waw-prefixed raiti instances this writer names at web:Eccl.3.22 and web:Eccl.4.4 in the neighboring P01-024).
findings.evidence: byte tier, verse_map_oshb.json: Eccl.3.22 = 'וְרָאִ֗יתִי כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין טוֹב֙ מֵאֲשֶׁ֨ר יִשְׂמַ֤ח הָאָדָם֙ בְּֽמַעֲשָׂ֔יו כִּי ה֖וּא חֶלְק֑וֹ כִּ֣י מִ֤י יְבִיאֶ֨נּוּ֙ לִרְא֔וֹת בְּמֶ֖ה שֶׁיִּהְיֶ֥ה אַחֲרָֽיו' (ends ...לִרְא֔וֹת בְּמֶ֖ה...); Eccl.4.1 opens 'וְשַׁ֣בְתִּֽי אֲנִ֗י וָאֶרְאֶה֙ אֶת כָּל...'. draft_rows_combined.jsonl's own pre-repair device_notes for P01-017 hedged this as '...not in a shared-root catchword this writer can name from the bytes' (a scoping limitation); rows_v1.jsonl/rows_v2.jsonl's repaired text upgrades this to the stronger, unqualified 'carries no shared-root catchword this writer can name from the bytes -- confirmed empty', which the bytes do not support.

findings.claim: Repair-installed boundary_rationale asserts a byte-tallied 26-infinitival/3-non-infinitival split of the time catalogue's 29 et-slots, but the Hebrew span cited as one of the 3 non-infinitival 'closing pair' exceptions -- וְעֵ֣ת לִשְׂנֹ֔א ('and a time to hate') -- is itself one of the row's own counted 26 infinitival tokens (the row names this same word, alongside לֶֽאֱהֹב֙, as 'the first pair of 3:8' two clauses earlier in the same sentence); the verse's actual closing pair, which does govern nouns, is עֵ֥ת מִלְחָמָ֖ה וְעֵ֥ת שָׁלֽוֹם ('a time for war, and a time for peace'), never quoted.
findings.evidence: byte tier, verse_map_oshb.json Eccl.3.8 full text: 'עֵ֤ת לֶֽאֱהֹב֙ וְעֵ֣ת לִשְׂנֹ֔א עֵ֥ת מִלְחָמָ֖ה וְעֵ֥ת שָׁלֽוֹם'. The row's own boundary_rationale reads (rows_v1.jsonl/rows_v2.jsonl): '26 of its 29 et-slots govern an infinitive across 3:2-3:7 and the first pair of 3:8 ... the remaining 3 govern nouns or a prepositional phrase -- 3:1's own ... and 3:8's closing pair וְעֵ֣ת לִשְׂנֹ֔א'. לִשְׂנֹ֔א is a lamed-prefixed infinitive construct (parallel to לֶֽאֱהֹב֙, both already counted as infinitival earlier in the very same sentence), not a noun/prepositional-phrase token; the true closing pair is עֵ֥ת מִלְחָמָ֖ה וְעֵ֥ת שָׁלֽוֹם. This citation-object error is new in the repair: draft_rows_combined.jsonl's pre-repair boundary_rationale made the (also false) blanket claim that 'every line follows the et-plus-infinitive template' with no re-tally at all.
